name: Loyalty Points and Rewards for Square
author: wumento

sections.description:
Square Loyalty Points & Reward for WooCommerce integrates Square Loyalty Rewards in your WooCommerce store and automatically syncs Square loyalty points between WooCommerce and Square.

The plugin allows customers to earn Square reward points from WooCommerce purchases and view their Square Loyalty balance directly inside their WooCommerce account.

Square Loyalty settings, reward rules, and customer rewards are automatically synced using the Square Loyalty API, making it easy to run a complete Square Rewards program on WooCommerce.

This plugin is ideal for WooCommerce stores using Square payments that want:
• Square Loyalty integration.
• Square Rewards synchronization.
• Square loyalty points for WooCommerce.
• Square customer rewards.
• Square rewards redemption.
• WooCommerce Square loyalty rewards.

⚡ Prerequisites

This plugin Requires WooCommerce Square Plugin pre-installed on your WooCommerce setup in order to work correctly. Contact our support on this support@wumento.com​ if you face any issue setting it up in your on your WooCommerce site. Our support will help you personally to add Square Loyalty Program in your square account.

Free Support

Many people find it difficult to set up Square Loyalty Program in their square account so we provide free support to setup Square loyalty program and also setting up this plugin on WooCommerce setup. Contact our support team for free support support@wumento.com​

Help us to make this plugin bug free

If you find a bug in the plugin, please email us on this email support@wumento.com . We will highly appreciate it.​

Loyalty Points & Rewards for Square Highlights

This plugin creates a square loyalty account for customers on Square and adds points using API whenever a user purchased a product on WooCommerce. Customer will earn loyalty/rewards points based on the loyalty program settings on store owners’ Square account’s loyalty program settings. Customer’s loyalty points remain sync seamlessly once customer account is created between Square and Woocommerce.

Users will be able to view their accumulated Square Loyalty Points right on my account section of WooCommerce store.

Square Loyalty Points % Rewards Features for WooCommerce

Free version includes following features:

✅ Square account automatically gets created when when a user purchase an item on WooCommerce store.

✅ Square rewards points automatically accumulated when an order is validated, completed and passes the square loyalty program settings.

✅ Square loyalty points can be seen in user’s my account page.

✅ Square and WooCommerce will start seamless syncing once a user purchases an item on the WooCommerce.

✅ Free support to help shop owners to setup this plugin, if user is facing any difficulty to setup this plugin. Contact us on support@wumento.com .

✅ Free support for shop owners if shop owner is facing difficulty to setup Square loyalty program on the Square site. Contact us on support@wumento.com

Premium Square Rewards Features

Premium version includes all the features of light version plus premium features as follows

✅ Square loyalty points can be used to redeem square rewards online during checkout on your WooCommerce setup.

✅ More settings in admin to control the label of Redeem section on checkout page.

✅ Auto adjustment of Square loyalty & rewards points if customer redeems the points online on WooCommerce Store.

✅ Seamless sync between WooCommerce and Square site.

✅ Premium and priority support to help shop owners to setup this plugin, if user is facing any difficulty to setup this plugin.

✅ Setting up Square Loyalty points itself can be a complicated job for shop owners. We provide premium and priority support for shop owners if shop owner is facing difficulty to setup Square loyalty program on the Square site.

External Services

This plugin connects to the following external services to enable Square loyalty
integration with WooCommerce. These services are required for the plugin to function.

Wumento Middleware (middleware.wumento.com)

This service is used to connect your WooCommerce store to your Square account. It
creates and validates authentication tokens to establish a secure connection between
WooCommerce and Square.

It sends authentication tokens during the initial store connection setup and whenever
the authentication token needs to be validated. No customer or store data is stored
in any external location during this process — everything remains in your WordPress
database.

This service is provided by Wumento:
Terms of Service: https://wumento.com/terms-and-conditions/
Privacy Policy: https://wumento.com/privacy-policy/

Wumento API (api.wumento.com)

This service acts as an intermediary between your WooCommerce store and Square’s API.
All requests are sent to api.wumento.com, which communicates with Square on your
behalf, processes the response, and returns the result to your store.

During admin setup, it sends the selected store location and authentication token to
retrieve loyalty program details from Square.

On the frontend, it sends the customer’s email address, phone number, and order total
when checking loyalty point balances and when awarding points after a completed order.

Data is only transmitted for real-time processing and is not stored in any external
location — everything remains in your WordPress database.

This service is provided by Wumento:
Terms of Service: https://wumento.com/terms-and-conditions/
Privacy Policy: https://wumento.com/privacy-policy/

Square (squareup.com)

Because api.wumento.com communicates with Square on your behalf, customer and order
data is also transmitted to Square’s servers for loyalty processing.

This service is provided by Square:
Terms of Service: https://squareup.com/us/en/legal/general/ua
Privacy Policy: https://squareup.com/us/en/legal/general/privacy
sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

AUTOMATIC INSTALLATION (EASIEST WAY)

To do an automatic install of ‘Loyalty Points & Rewards for Square’, log in to your WordPress dashboard, navigate to the Plugins menu and click Add New.
In the search field type ‘Loyalty Points & Rewards for Square’.

Once you have found it you can install it by simply clicking “Install Now” and then “Activate”.

MANUAL INSTALLATION

Installing through WordPress Dashboard

  • Download loyalty-points-and-rewards-for-square.zip
  • Navigate to the ‘Add New’ in the plugins dashboard
  • Navigate to the ‘Upload’ area
  • Select loyalty-points-and-rewards-for-square.zip from your computer
  • Click ‘Install Now’
  • Activate the plugin in the Plugin dashboard

Using FTP

  • Download loyalty-points-and-rewards-for-square.zip
  • Extract the loyalty-points-and-rewards-for-square.zip to your computer
  • Upload the loyalty-points-and-rewards-for-square folder directory to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  • Activate the plugin in the Plugin dashboard.
sections.faq:
Q. Is there any Prerequisites in order to use this plugin ?

A. This plugin requires WooCommerce Square plugin installed on your WooCommerce setup in order to work correctly.

Q. What is square loyalty program ?

A. Square loyalty program is a feature on Square site which enables Square Points & Rewards work on Square POS or online using API.

Q. Can I redeem points using this plugin in Free version ?

A. No. Free version only allows points to earn on purchase. If you want your customer to redeem online too, you need to buy Premium version of this plugin.

Q. I have a question about the plugin where should I contact ?

A. You can go to plugin support on this link and can raise support ticket. We will get back to you within 24-48 hours.

Q. How can I request a feature or encourage future development ?

A. You can go to plugin support on this link and can raise support ticket. We will get back to you within 24-48 hours.
